inspection_method: Viewed recovered 1159x1358 original sheet before authoring, not just catalogue prose.
observations: KP2 lifts the brow centers and parts the lips; KP3-4 look upward with increasingly heavy ordinary lids. KP5 has a larger unsmiling exhale and about half-closed eyes; KP6 tapers it; KP7 remains tired with a smaller opening; KP8 reseals and settles; KP9 is neutral. No smiling-eye substitution.
intermediate_anchor: exhale_onset is an authored interpolation waypoint, not a tenth recovered source pose.

control_mapping.brows: Existing rigid outer-anchor rotation: -26*inner_lift degrees screen-left, +26*inner_lift screen-right; whole-brow y=-10*brow. No local hook deformation.
control_mapping.lids: blink_R controls screen-left, blink_L screen-right; ordinary lash y=36*blink, max 18 source pixels. No full closure or smiling lids.
control_mapping.gaze: gaze_y in [-1,0] gives [-2,0] source-pixel vertical offset. At 0.49 bust scale this is <=0.98 display pixels: a subtle glance, explicitly not a full eye roll.
control_mapping.mouth: Existing split-lip aperture with MAX_MOUTH_APERTURE=0.55 and symmetric purse. At peak central gap=0.50*0.55*54-1.5*0.26=14.46 source pixels. No smile, spread, width, independent corners or lip press.

limitations: The source calls for an eye roll; current approved assets permit only a subtle upward glance. This partial fit must be made explicit at review.
Rigid whole brow strips cannot reproduce the painted inner hooks or localized furrows.
Purse is existing contour articulation, not independent downturned mouth anatomy.
No body/shoulder breath acting, actual airflow, new jaw action, lip sync or sound.
Native eye coverage, lip seams, appearance, perceptual distinctness and real-time pacing remain NOT RUN.
A numerically different trajectory does not establish visual success or user approval.
approval: Unapproved. Accepted reference art is not animation approval.
